verses.text: Ix yak'anb'at jun ab'ix winh rey t'a yol masanil smakb'en icha tik: Ha in rey Nabucodonosor in tik, swak' stzatzil he k'ool he masanil ex chonhab', ma ex nakión yalxonhej tas ti'al tzeyala', a ex masanil ex kajan ex t'a yol yib'anhk'inal tik.
In gana tzeyojtakejel he masanil tastak satub'tak ix sk'ulej Dios Niwan Yelk'och t'ayin.
Te satub'takxonhej tas sk'ulej, manh jantakok spoder, Yajal ton t'a masanil tiempo, a yopisio malaj slajwub'.
Ha in Nabucodonosor in tik, tzalajk'olal wajek' t'a in palakio.
Palta ha t'a jun ak'wal, ay jun tas ix in wayichej. Ha yuj tas ix wil chi' yet' tas ix in na'a, ix in te xiwi.
Yuj chi' ix in chek awtajkot masanil heb' jelan t'a Babilonia tik, yik syalan heb' tas syalelk'och in wayich chi'.
Ix jawi heb' smasanil: Haton heb' ajb'aal, heb' naumel lolonel, heb' schuman yet' k'een k'anal yet' heb' ajchum. Ix walan in wayich chi' t'a heb', palta maj yal-laj heb' t'ayin tas syalelk'ochi.
Stzak'anilxo ix jawi winhaj Daniel, skuchan pax Beltsasar, icha sb'i in diosal, ayoch sjelanil juntzanh Dios t'a winh. Ix walan in wayich chi' t'a winh icha tik:

Ach Beltsasar, yajal aj t'a skal heb' jelan spensar, wojtak to ayoch sjelanil juntzanh Dios t'ayach, ojtakpax masanil tas satub'tak. Scham wal ab'ani tas ix wil t'a in wayich, ol alan t'ayin tas syalelk'ochi.
Haton wal in wayich ix wil tik ayik jichan in ek' in wayi: Ha t'a snanhal lum lum tik ix wil jun te te' te chaanh steel.
Ix q'uib'chaanh te', te niwan ix aj spatik te'. Ha schon te', ix k'ek'och t'a satcha'anh, chekel te' masanto b'aj slajwik'och lum lum.

Te wach' yilji xil te', manh jantakok sat te', k'okb'il wal syab' sat te' chi' sloan masanil anima. Axo masanil nok' nok', tz'och nok' sk'ub'ej sb'a t'a yenhul yich te'. Axo t'a sk'ab'tak te' sb'o so' nok' much, haxo masanil tas pitzan t'a yol yib'anhk'inal tik, k'okb'il swatzitaj heb' yuj sat te'.
Axo ix aj jun, ix wilan jun ángel t'a in wayich chi', to stanhwej yol yib'anhk'inal tik, wan yemta t'a satcha'anh.

Te chaanh ix el yaw, ix yalan icha tik: Ch'akekel te te' chi', xikekel sk'ab' te', tzeyik'anel xil te', tze saklemanb'at sat te' chi' smasanil. Saklemokab'kanb'at masanil nok' nok' ayoch t'a yalanh yenhul te' yet' masanil nok' much ayoch t'a sk'ab'tak te'.

Axonhej yib' te' tzeyaktejkani, tze tzek'ankan te' yib' chi' yet' k'een kadena to hierro yet' bronke. Skan jun chi' t'a skal anh ank'ultak chi', haxo yal ak'wal ol em t'a yib'anh, haxo anh ank'ultak ol sk'ux icha nok' kaltakte'al nok'.
Ol ixtaxel spensar. Lajanxo ol aj spensar icha spensar nok' nok'. Ha jun makan yaelal chi', uke' ab'il ol yak'a'.

Ha onh ángel onh sko tanhwej yol yib'anhk'inal tik, a onh skala' to ol jawok jun yaelal tik t'a yib'anh, yik wach' syojtakejel heb' anima smasanil to ha Dios Niwan Yelk'ochi, ay yopisio t'a yib'anhtak nakión. Ha tz'ak'an opisio t'a mach snib'ej syak'ochi, syalpax yak'anoch junok mach emnakil yajalilok junok nakión, xchi jun ángel chi'.

Haton in wayich ix wil tik. Ha tiknaik ach Beltsasar, al t'ayin tas syalelk'ochi, yujto malaj wal junokxo heb' ay tas syal yuj t'a yol in makb'en tik snachajel yuj. Palta a ach tik ol yal snachajel uuj, yujto ayoch sjelanil juntzanh Dios t'ayach, xin chi.

Axo winhaj Daniel chi', haton winh skuchpax Beltsasar, ken am manh junok hora ix kan numan winh. Ix somchajk'e spensar winh, palta ix walan t'a winh: Beltsasar, manh ak' pensar yuj jun in wayich chi' yet' tas syalelk'ochi, xin chi. Ix yalan winh t'ayin: Ay mamin rey, komonok wal t'a yib'anh heb' ayoch ajk'olal t'ayach ol em tas syalelk'och jun a wayich tik.
Mamin rey, a jun te te' te chaanh steel ix il chi', haton jun te' ix k'ek'och t'a satcha'anh, te' ix cheklaj t'a najat,

te' wach' yilji xiil, te' tzijtum sat, te' k'okb'ilnhej syab' sat sloan masanil tas pitzan, te' b'aj tz'och masanil nok' nok' sk'ub'ej sb'a t'a yalanh yenhul sk'ab', te' b'aj sb'o so' nok' much t'a skaltak sk'ab',
a ach ton tik mamin rey. To ix ach k'enhejchaanh yuj sniwanil elk'och chi'. Ix k'ek'och a b'inajnakil t'a satcha'anh. Yajal ach t'a masanil yol yib'anhk'inal tik.

Ix ilanpax yemta jun ángel stanhwumal yol yib'anhk'inal tik t'a satcha'anh, ix yalani: Ch'akek telwok te niwan te' chi', yik slajwiem te'. Axonhej yib' te' yet' sch'anhal yib' tzeyak'kani. Stzek'chajkan yib' te' yet' k'een kadena to hierro yet' bronke, skan t'a kaltak ank'ultak. Emokab' yal ak'wal t'a yib'anh ta', ol kajnaj yet' nok' nok' ukeok ab'il.
Ha syalelk'och jun tik mamin rey, a jun Dios Niwan Yelk'ochi, ha' tz'alan jun tik t'a ib'anh.

Ol ach pechchajel t'a skal heb' anima tik. Ol ach b'atkan t'a skal nok' nok', haxo anh ank'ultak ol a k'ux icha nok' wakax. Ol em yal ak'wal t'a ib'anh. Mamin rey, icha chi' ol ach ajek' ukeok ab'il, masanto ol nachajel uuj to a jun Dios Niwan Yelk'ochi, ha' yajal yaj t'a yib'anh heb' anima. Ha tz'ak'anpaxoch heb' yajal icha snib'ej mach syak'ochi.
Ha jun lolonel ix alchaji to skan yib' te' yet' sch'anhal yib' chi', syalelk'ochi to ol ach k'ochxok t'a opisio chi' ayik toxo ix nachajel uuj to ha Dios yajal yaj t'a yol yib'anhk'inal tik.

Yuj chi' mamin rey, cha ab' masanil juntzanh lolonel swal tik t'ayach. Yuj chi' tojolnhej tzutej a b'a, manhxo ak'och a mul. Komonok wal tzaktejkan a k'ulan chukal, tzach kolwaj t'a heb' tz'ixtaji. Tato icha chi', tekan ol ach kan t'a junk'olal yet' a k'echaanh t'a masanil tasi, xchi winhaj Daniel chi' t'ayin, xchi winh rey Nabucodonosor chi'.
Masanil juntzanh lolonel ix alchaj t'a winhaj rey Nabucodonosor chi', ix elk'ochi.
Yab'ilal yalchaj juntzanh chi' t'a winh rey chi', ayik wan sb'eyek' winh t'a spanhanil yib'anh spalakio t'a Babilonia,
ix yalan winh icha tik: Ina wal yilji niwan chonhab' Babilonia tik. Ha in yet' wal in poder ix in b'ok'ei yik scheklajeli to niwan welk'ochi, xchi winh.

Wanto wal yalan juntzanh lolonel chi' winh, ix yab'an winh yoch jun lolonel t'a satcha'anh, ix yalani: Scham ab'an juntzanh lolonel tik ach rey Nabucodonosor, a opisio chi', toxo ix ik'chajek' t'ayach.

Ol ach pechchajel t'a skal heb' anima, ol ach b'atkan t'a skal nok' nok'. Ha anh ank'ultak ol a k'ux ichok nok' nok' t'a ukeok ab'il, masanto ol yal snachajel uuj to ha Dios Niwan Yelk'ochi, ha' tz'ak'an yajalil t'a yib'anh masanil anima yet' t'a yib'anh masanil nakión t'a yol yib'anhk'inal tik. A' tz'ak'anoch t'a yajalil mach snib'ej syak'ochi, xchi jun lolonel chi'.

Ha t'a jun rato chi', ix elk'och tas alb'ilkan t'a yib'anh winhaj rey Nabucodonosor chi', ix pechchajkanel winh t'a skal heb' anima. Ha anh ank'ultak ix sk'ux winh icha nok' wakax, haxo yal ak'wal ix em t'a yib'anh sniwanil winh. Ix q'uib' xiil winh icha nok' ch'akb'a, anheja' icha yech nok' ix aj k'een yech winh.

Ix yalanpaxb'at winh rey chi' icha tik: Ayik ix lajwi stiempoal yaelal ayoch t'a wib'anh a in Nabucodonosor in tik, ix in k'e k'elan t'a satcha'anh, ix b'o in pensar t'a in lokoal. Ix walan wach' lolonel t'a Dios Te Niwan Yelk'ochi, ix wik'anchaanh sb'i Jun aynhejek' t'a junelnhej: Yujto Yajal ton t'a junelnhej, a yopisio malaj slajwub'.

Ha t'a yichanh, malaj wal jab'ok tas syal yuj heb' kajan t'a sat lu'um tik. Sk'ulejnhej tas snib'ej t'a skal heb' ayek' t'a satcha'anh yet' t'a skal heb' kajan t'a sat lu'um tik. Malaj mach syal syamanoch waan sk'ab' syalan t'ay, ¿tas yuj icha chi' tza k'ulej? manh xchiok.

Ha t'a jun rato chi', ix meltzaj in pensar ix wab'i yet' wik'anxi wopisio niwan yelk'ochi yet' in poder. Axo heb' in chekab' yet' heb' niwak yopisio t'a in despacho, ix jawi heb' ul in sayeq'ui. Ix in ochxi yajalil t'a in nakión, ix yik'anxi yip wopisio. Te niwan ix ajxi t'a yichanh icha yaj t'a yalanhtaxo.

Ha tiknaik, a in wal swik'chaanh Jun sReyal satcha'anh. Swalanpax wach' lolonel t'ay, yujto a masanil tas sk'ulej, wach'nhej, tojolnhej t'a smasanil. Syalpax yik'anemta heb' syaloch sb'a to niwan yelk'ochi, xchib'at winhaj Nabucodonosor chi'.
